jq @1.7.1 (textproc)
Sub-ports:            jq-devel

Lightweight and flexible command-line JSON processor.
jq is like sed for JSON data: slice, filter, map and transform.

Homepage:             https://jqlang.github.io/jq/

Library Dependencies: oniguruma6
Platforms:            darwin
